vocabulary.definition: an extremely large number, typically referring to a quantity in the trillions (1,000,000,000,000)
vocabulary.example: The company's revenue last year amounted to trillions of dollars.

vocabulary.definition: a soft, transparent, and semi-solid substance, often sweet and fruit-flavored
vocabulary.example: She spread some grape jelly on her toast for breakfast.

vocabulary.definition: openly resist or refuse to obey
vocabulary.example: The team's unbeaten record defies all expectations.

vocabulary.definition: a figure of speech in which a word or phrase is applied to an object or action to which it is not literally applicable
vocabulary.example: Her smile was a metaphor for sunshine on a rainy day.

vocabulary.definition: a feeling of reverential respect mixed with fear or wonder
vocabulary.example: The majestic view of the mountains filled them with awe.

vocabulary.definition: reciprocal action or influence between two or more things
vocabulary.example: The interactions between the chemicals produced unexpected results.
